contrast_direction: larger retina minus paired current-board montage
limitations: Three paired head/sampler seeds; initial core strengths are not independently randomized.
Conditional opening-family intervals hold the fitted weights fixed; they are not training-seed confidence intervals.
Same 9x9 board and information, different angular allocation/aspect ratio/drive; no gain correction.
Reduced-source novelty precedes rendering and does not certify absence of FP32 image collisions.
Raw response variance and decoder influence alone do not prove predictive usefulness.
No final-test evaluation, new matched CNN result, playing-strength claim, head constraint, memory, optimizer change or TPU use.

novelty.scope: Exact D4-canonical reduced source inputs before rendering. Neutral keys describe actual constant-vision inputs; current keys do not certify absence of FP32 retinal collisions. No labels or final-test examples inspected.

plan.name: retinal-allocation-v1
plan.scope: One larger current board per eye versus the adopted paired current-board montage endpoints. Same original immutable learner, ports, information, initialization, K8 and 32k exposure/optimizer contract. Only retinal sampling changes. Dense learned policy/value heads remain the baseline. No head-mask, physiology, memory, optimizer, final-test or TPU intervention.

publication_transform: Only per-batch inference pass traces are omitted; every metric, paired interval, seed variation and aggregate arithmetic statistic is retained.
